QuestInfo.name: Save the Cat 2
QuestInfo.0: You jury-rigged some branches to break the trap, but the cat looks worried instead of grateful. Ask it what's wrong.
QuestInfo.1: Aww, the cat lost its little bell up in the tree. Press the #bCtrl#k key to attack the tree, then press #bZ#k to grab the key.
QuestInfo.2: You got the bell and gave it to the cat.

default.0: Bell, bell, come back to me! Ctrl to attack the tree, Z to pick up the bell!
